en.headline: Buildings Department applies tighter national standard for scaffold safety nets
en.dek: From 1 September, contractors must test nets manufactured under GB 5725-2025, which sets a two-second limit on afterflame and afterglow for dip-coated nets.
body: The Buildings Department has been applying the updated national standard GB 5725-2025 for fall-protection safety nets since 1 September, replacing the 2009 version.

The new standard classifies nets by manufacturing method: twisted-woven, brushed warp knitted, and dip-coated. Twisted-woven and brushed warp knitted nets must still meet a maximum afterflame and afterglow time of four seconds, but the limit for dip-coated nets is tightened to two seconds.

Contractors using nets manufactured on or after 1 September under the GB 5725 standard must have their flame-retardant performance tested according to the new requirements. The standard also requires clearer marking of the manufacturing method.

The change follows heightened scrutiny of scaffold netting after the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po last year. Industry representatives said the tighter rules for dip-coated nets address their faster loss of flame-retardant properties under sunlight.

zh.headline: 屋宇署採用更嚴格棚網國標 浸漬塗覆網阻燃要求收緊至兩秒
zh.dek: 自9月1日起，承建商須按GB 5725-2025新標準測試新製棚網，浸漬塗覆網的續燃及陰燃時間上限由四秒收緊至兩秒。
body: 屋宇署自9月1日起採用最新國家標準GB 5725-2025《墜落防護安全網》，取代2009年舊版本。
新標準按製造方法將棚網分為絞合編織、拉絲經編及浸漬塗覆三類。絞合編織及拉絲經編網的續燃、陰燃時間仍不得多於四秒，浸漬塗覆網則收緊至不多於兩秒。
使用9月1日或之後按GB 5725標準製造的棚網，承建商必須按新要求進行阻燃效能測試。新標準亦規定須清楚標示製造方法。
是次更新是在去年大埔宏福苑火災後，公眾對棚網防火安全高度關注之下推出。業界指浸漬塗覆網在日照下阻燃性能較易消退，收緊標準有助提升工地安全。
